description:
Research position overview

The HEPAGING project develops an in vitro model to study liver senescence and its relationship with systemic ageing. The doctoral researcher joins IBEC's Biosensors for Bioengineering group, working within a project on cellular senescence and communication between organs.

Research Areas

  • Cellular senescence
  • Liver ageing
  • Biosensors

Funding and duration

ComponentDetails
Award or positionPhD scholarship / studentship
Stipend / salaryEUR 24,550 gross/year years 1–3; EUR 25,500 year 4
DurationFour-year predoctoral contract

The shared FPI call also provides mobility and training support; university enrolment fees are covered under the call conditions.

Eligibility and Requirements

CriterionRequirement
Applicant eligibilityProgramme and project criteria apply; see official eligibility guidance
Further conditionsFour-year contract; shared FPI competition with distinct project preference.

ComponentDetails

LocationSpain

About Institute for Bioengineering of Catalonia (IBEC)

IBEC is a bioengineering research institute in Barcelona. Its doctoral researchers work within research groups and enrol for the doctorate at a university; IBEC supplies the research environment and predoctoral contract.
